program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((shape (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 8)) (objects g 0))))
         (pivot (first (find-color g 9)))
         (code (third (first (filter (lambda (cell) (let ((v (third cell))) (and (>= v 1) (<= v 4)))) (grid-cells g))))))
    (foldl (lambda (p out)
             (let* ((dr (- (first p) (first pivot)))
                    (dc (- (second p) (second pivot)))
                    (nrnc (cond [(= code 1) (list (+ (first pivot) dr) (+ (second pivot) dc))]
                                [(= code 2) (list (+ (first pivot) dc) (- (second pivot) dr))]
                                [(= code 3) (list (- (first pivot) dr) (- (second pivot) dc))]
                                [else (list (- (first pivot) dc) (+ (second pivot) dr))]))
                    (nr (first nrnc))
                    (nc (second nrnc)))
               (if (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                   (set-cell out nr nc 2)
                   out)))
           g
           (obj-cells shape))))
